note: Canonical claim set for the whole project. Every entry lists each document that repeats or depends on it, with a short verbatim fragment used to locate the statement. verify_claims.py checks presence, label agreement near each occurrence, numeric agreement, negative scope, and absence of withdrawn claims from conclusions.

claims.statement: The charger negotiates 20 V at 3.390 A (67.80 W) on the MagSafe port.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: Four HPM controllers are present at RID 0, 1, 2 and 5; RID 5 carries the MagSafe port.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: HPM controller firmware FW003.115.00, the MagSafe cable at 3.2.0 and the adapter value 1030030 are three distinct objects, not revisions of one image.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: The UARP SuperBinary container is a 44-byte header with 40-byte payload records; dataOffset plus dataLength reconciles in all four files.
claims.label: REPRODUCED

claims.statement: Three MagSafe 3 releases were acquired and each SHA-1 matches Apple's manifest _Measurement.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: The power-negotiation table content (5/9/15/20 V at 3.00 A) is identical in all builds while its address moves.
claims.label: REPRODUCED

claims.statement: Exactly one Apple SVID literal changes across the three releases: 0x05AC0002 disappears and 0x05AC0000 gains an occurrence.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: Between 3.1.12 and 3.2.0 the compared bodies share 11 non-trivial literals, lose 7 and gain 1; 28 is present only in 3.2.0.
claims.label: REPRODUCED

claims.statement: The vector word at 0x0001111d points to 0x1111c, which is constant data and not a reset handler.
claims.label: REFUTED

claims.statement: The 140 W control image's pointers 0xec89 and 0xec71 exceed its 0xea00 payload, which rules out a base-zero mapping only; a non-zero base such as 0x400 would place them inside.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: The frame header formula (sop<<4)|ceil(bytes/4) reproduces the observed 0x21 for SOP selector 2 and a 4-byte payload; the meaning of the sop field outside the observed selector set is open.
claims.label: REPRODUCED
bans: only `0x21` and the observed VDO count

claims.statement: A 14-case mov-pc dispatch table with 6 unique targets and 8 of 14 cases to one target is present in both 3.1.x builds and is not detected in 3.2.0.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: The 15-case and 13-case tables in 3.2.0 are candidates only; no correspondence to the 3.1.x switch is shown.
claims.label: OPEN

claims.statement: Claims that 3.2.0 replaced or reorganised the dispatcher, or is a rebuild rather than a patch, are withdrawn.
claims.label: REFUTED
bans: is a rebuild, not a patch

claims.statement: The Apple SVID literal sites are not established as a UVDM builder; that identification remains unverified.
claims.label: UNVERIFIED

claims.statement: The 5.9 % / 73.1 % aligned-window overlap figures measure layout; the inference from them to a rewrite is refuted.
claims.label: REFUTED

claims.statement: Ghidra function coverage is 38.8 / 39.4 / 43.3 % of image bytes, and the switch and literal sites lie outside the analysed set.
claims.label: REPRODUCED

claims.statement: Hard-reset handling change is refuted: Hard_Reset has no MessageType, so a 9-22 message-type switch cannot speak to it.
claims.label: REFUTED

claims.statement: No soft-to-hard reset escalation ladder was found; the question stays open across all three images.
claims.label: OPEN

claims.statement: 70 W adapter firmware was not found by three enumeration methods (mesu path probes, Pallas lookup with a control type, and a broad type sweep); this is a scoped negative, not proof of nonexistence.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: Signature enforcement below the manifest hash, anti-rollback, and whether the Mode 7 read verb can touch flash are all open.
claims.label: OPEN

claims.statement: hpmdiagnose reads the full HPM register file unprivileged; access is entitlement-gated, not root-gated.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: Semantic equivalence of 3.2.0 to 3.1.12 is undeterminable at the achieved coverage and is open.
claims.label: OPEN

claims.statement: The entry-point question is OPEN: offset 0x10 is the empirical start, not a proven entry, and 0x1111c holds peripheral addresses.
claims.label: OPEN
bans: Closed since the last revision of this document: the entry-point

claims.statement: The 140 W control image does not corroborate a base-zero layout for the MagSafe images.
claims.label: REFUTED

claims.statement: The three firmware objects are not equally established: the adapter value is host-reported only, and the cable version is a single in-file source consistent with register 0x49.
claims.label: OBSERVED

claims.statement: 3.2.0 contains 10 detected mov-pc dispatch sites, not 15.
claims.label: REPRODUCED
